---
title: "The 365 days"
subtitle: "Friday, 7 August 2026 → Friday, 6 August 2027"
toc-depth: 2
---

Six study days, then a lighter seventh, fifty-two times over, then the capstone. Every seventh day is a Thursday and is deliberately unallocated. Eleven of those seventh days are milestones instead, where the week's work turns into something you could show someone.

| Phase | Weeks | Days | When |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| [Markets](#markets) | 1–4 | 1–28 | August 2026 – September 2026 |
| [Returns and noise](#returns-and-noise) | 5–9 | 29–63 | September 2026 – October 2026 |
| [Time series](#time-series) | 10–14 | 64–98 | October 2026 – November 2026 |
| [Portfolios and risk](#portfolios-and-risk) | 15–19 | 99–133 | November 2026 – December 2026 |
| [The research harness](#the-research-harness) | 20–23 | 134–161 | December 2026 – January 2027 |
| [Alpha](#alpha) | 24–29 | 162–203 | January 2027 – February 2027 |
| [Machine learning](#machine-learning) | 30–34 | 204–238 | February 2027 – April 2027 |
| [Derivatives](#derivatives) | 35–40 | 239–280 | April 2027 – May 2027 |
| [Microstructure](#microstructure) | 41–44 | 281–308 | May 2027 – June 2027 |
| [Production](#production) | 45–47 | 309–329 | June 2027 – July 2027 |
| [The interview](#the-interview) | 48–51 | 330–357 | July 2027 |
| [Capstone](#capstone) | 52 | 358–365 | July 2027 – August 2027 |

::: {.timeline}
